reason: The align-items mixin that this patch adds at app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:117-123 emits `-ms-align-items` on line 121. No browser implements that property, so browsers ignore it. IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, which the mixin already emits on line 120, and IE11/Edge use plain `align-items` (line 122).
